legacy_policy: Do not automatically upgrade a legacy Other value. The old list did not specify how omitted categories or non-disclosure were recorded. Retain the original value and version, or seek source information for reclassification. A lossy six-category analytical roll-up must be labelled as an OWHS aggregation, with its mapping and non-disclosure handling disclosed; it is not the ONS Other category. Never infer the four missing categories by splitting an aggregate Other total.
missing_data: A null or unanswered reason is not converted to prefers-not-to-give-details; those mean different things. A missing reason is not guessed to make a required field validate.
